ACCOUNT & DATA DELETION

Your profile.
Your choice.

Flap Fit does not require an email, phone number, or password. An anonymous online profile is created only if you accept the Competition Terms and use Compete.

Delete in the app

  1. Open Flap Fit.
  2. Open the Info tab.
  3. Select Delete online profile.
  4. Confirm Delete.

If you want a record that support can use to identify the correct anonymous profile, open Info and select Online profile support ID before deleting the app. Keep that identifier private and share it only with Flap Fit Support.

What is deleted: the anonymous authentication user and associated player name, leaderboard scores, challenges, challenge attempts, and blocks. Local bird, level, score, and training history stored only on the phone are not deleted by this action.

WITHOUT THE APP

Request deletion by email

Email support@flapfitapp.com with the subject ‘Flap Fit account deletion’ and include the exact Online profile support ID previously shared from the app's Info tab. You may also include your player name to help us check the request, but a player name, score, challenge code, date, or screenshot alone is not proof that you own the profile.

Do not send camera images, workout videos, passwords, government identification, or other sensitive information. We will acknowledge the request within seven calendar days and complete a verified request within 30 calendar days, unless applicable law requires a faster response.

If you no longer have the app and did not save the support ID, contact support for the privacy-safe options that remain available. Flap Fit will not disclose or delete another player's data based only on public competition details.

Email deletion request ↗

What may be retained temporarily

The live service removes the online account, public competition rows, and associated run-verification records. When an account remains active, run-verification records expire after six hours and the daily cleanup removes them after they have been expired for seven days.

Pending moderation reports remain until review. Resolved reports are removed after 180 days, but an account identifier is removed sooner when its associated account is deleted. Security logs and backups may remain for the limited periods configured by the production provider before automatic deletion or rotation.

Privacy questions

Read the Privacy Policy or contact Flap Fit Support at support@flapfitapp.com.
